verdicts.output: Head lines 98-106 give only the match case: 'If a page whose **Source-Id** matches carries engram_id and no memorycard_id ... blocked'. They say nothing for an error, vault_status other than ok, or zero rows, and do not define how Source-Id 'matches'. askVault returns VaultStatusNotProvisioned (not_provisioned) on ErrVaultNotProvisioned, VaultStatusError (error) plus a vault_subprocess_failed diagnostic on any other retriever error, and VaultStatusOK otherwise. result.go also defines not_requested. So the non-ok statuses exist and the text is silent on them. At base the vault pre-check is absent: the base SKILL.md vault mentions are lines 6, 24, 53, 89-99 (the BridgedError stop) and 123-138, and none is a pre-check. The defect is therefore introduced at head.

verdicts.command: rg -n 'BridgedError|engram_id|EngramID' longterm-mem/internal/promote/card.go; Read of card.go lines 186-226 (scanCardPages); Read of SKILL.md lines 98-106 at head
verdicts.output: card.go:86-87 returns BridgedError only when scan.bridged is set. scanCardPages sets scan.bridged only when a page's engram_id is in 'wanted', which holds just m.EngramID and m.SameContentEngramIDs (lines 193-198, 214-218). Matching is by Engram id, not by Source-Id. So a page carrying engram_id but no memorycard_id refuses only memories whose Engram id matches, not 'every memory of this source'. Head SKILL.md:100-103 says it 'would refuse every memory of this source'. That claim is not in the base text, which at 97-99 says only that a memory from an Engram observation that already has a vault page is refused.
